findings.summary: The self-initiated terminal is still emitted as a bare `done`/`error` and no read-side consumer filters on `selfInitiated`, so the F-2 symptom (a waiter is told the worker is finished while it is still processing the in-flight dispatch) persists for every consumer that keys on bare `done` — including the dispatcher pattern the bundled `trellis-channel` docs still recommend. The task's Decisions section deliberately keeps self terminals waking `wait --kind done`; the gap is that (a) the shipped guidance in workflows.md/workers.md/command-reference.md was not narrowed to `turn_finished`, and (b) `wait.ts`/`run.ts` had the new `selfInitiated` field available and it is unused. Not a regression introduced by C-3 (the self `done` was appended identically before), but the change is the point at which it became fixable.
findings.failure_scenario: Long-lived worker `eng-core` runs a background command (the exact F-2 setup). The background task finishes while dispatch message M (inputSeq 1139) has already been written to the worker's stdin (inbox.ts:123-138 begins M's turn before the write) but before the provider starts M's turn: the provider emits its notification turn, `parseClaudeLine`→`handleResult` stamps `done{selfInitiated:true}`, `applyParseResult` appends it (stdout.ts:203-221). A dispatcher running the documented pattern `trellis channel wait <ch> --as main --kind done --from eng-core --timeout 30m` (bundled `trellis-channel/references/workflows.md:25,66,96`, `workers.md:17`) has its wait return at that instant and proceeds to review/verify while eng-core is still editing M — the same premature-finish harm F-2 describes, for the `done`-keyed consumer class. `wait --kind turn_finished` and the bundled engine (channel.py:368-375) are unaffected, which is why the PRD scopes the decision to bare-`done` conductors; but the docs C-3 ships with still tell dispatchers to use bare `--kind done`.
findings.evidence: Read side has no self-initiated dimension: wait.ts:40-43 builds `WatchFilter` purely from `--kind` (plus from/to/thread/action); `grep -rn selfInitiated packages/core/src/channel/internal/store/filter.ts` → 0 hits; `matchesEventFilter` is the only read-side event predicate; the default/no-`--kind` wait set includes `done` (filter.ts:19). run.ts:117 `if (ev.kind === "done") return;` (waitForDone) likewise returns on any `done`. Producer side appends the self terminal keying only on `kind` (stdout.ts:203-221; only `markTerminalEmitted`/`turn_finished` are skipped for selfInitiated, per the PRD Decisions and research/stream-turns.md §Decisions). Shipped guidance recommending bare `--kind done` for 'worker finished': bundled-skills/trellis-channel/references/workflows.md:25,66,96 and workers.md:17; command-reference.md:171 ('Use `--kind done,turn_finished` for "worker finished a turn"'). Regression check: pre-C-3 `applyParseResult` appended the same self `done` (kind-only), so `wait --kind done` was equally misled before — C-3 neither introduces nor worsens it. Targeted runs all green: `vitest run test/commands/channel*` (packages/cli, 159 passed) and `test/channel/worker-state.test.ts` (packages/core, 27 passed); `tsc --noEmit` clean.
